final: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS tot FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, CAST(articount AS REAL)/(SELECT tot FROM t) AS share FROM scanfeatures WHERE articount IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT tot FROM t) IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT tot FROM t) <> 0), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT zoneref, articount, share, share - (SELECT avgshare FROM a) AS diff FROM s WHERE (SELECT avgshare FROM a) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
